## Authored

- Added the \(U(1)_V\) heavy-chiral model, conditional Wess–Zumino matching theorem, and compact-support example. With \(B\mapsto B+d\alpha\) and \(\theta\mapsto\theta-\alpha\), the heavy variation is \(+\frac{1}{24\pi^2}\int\alpha\,G\wedge G\), matched by \(\Gamma_{\mathrm{WZ}}=-\frac{1}{24\pi^2}\int\theta\,G\wedge G\). The sign follows Bilal’s consistent-anomaly convention; Preskill supports the mass-independent threshold interpretation. ([Bilal](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0802.0634), [Preskill](https://preskill.caltech.edu/pubs/preskill-1991-effective.pdf))

- Updated the A/B page inventories, manifest, proof contracts, coverage, cross-batch dependencies, and batch notes. The item statements now match the manifest, both pages have empty bodies, and all seven cross-batch edges are verified.

- Scoped checks passed: proof layout (3 items, 8 steps), precheck (2, no failures), strict contracts, manifest dependencies, content policy, rendering, focused dependency checks, and source fetch verification (4/4).

The batch-41 anomaly definitions and cubic-polynomial supplier now have current `ready` records, and the convention conversion is checked. The three batch-44 Step 1 records remain `escalated`; their hashes no longer match the final item/manifest inputs. The native tool rejected my attempt to update one with `Only the owner may resolve this record`. I left the records unchanged and did not use `--owner`; they require owner resolution to reflect the current inputs.

Run-wide dependency-level checks still report upstream inventory/level issues, and statement-first and proof-contract coverage stop at the empty batch-49 inventory `qftx-s3-partition-functions`. Details are in the [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-44.notes.md>).
